body:
[DTM] Celeritate

_______________________________________________________________




Title: Celeritate
Created By: Fluenza_, SweetMango, TheSolux
Game: Nebula (DTM)
Teams: Lime vs Purple
Images: http://imgur.com/ZqqG5R8&GlRKfFD&sHFLm6P&KUXhEll&Z0ULD8h&5uHDZ5b&rm1rpWa&PgecUre&W1kBLjG&JEWD2Uo&mrZUOGz&DwLWBAJ
YML: http://pastebin.com/amZ1G5Lk
Download: In Progress
Overview: This is a map that Mango, Fluenza and I have made. The basic idea was to create an unusual and creative style of game-play. The teams will be around 20v20.

Features:
- Jump Pads: Players will be able to hop around the map using jump pads, adding a unique sense of game-play.
- Each player receives Speed II and Jump Boost II
- Two classes selection: The two classes will have enchanted tools including an unbreaking 1, sharpness 1, and knockback 1 stone sword. As seen in the screenshots, there will be a stack of wood, golden carrots and glass. 3 golden apples and 1 splash potion of regeneration will also be available.
- Unique design: The design of the map uses an unusual palette of materials including large mushroom block.
- Focusing on gameplay.

Changelog

V1.0

ADDED:
YAML (http://pastebin.com/amZ1G5Lk)
   ---> Monument location holograms (for newer players)
   ---> Fall damage is off
   ---> Select classes
Removed:
Top of the board located near spectator spawn (embedded image).
Altered:
There are now 4 jump pads on each side, instead of 6.
Changed Speed II to Speed I.

Planned:

Add blindness to a player within a radius of X when near monument

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Very nice map. Nice palette and nice height differences and overall looks really good. The layout seems very nice and I feel it could be great for gameplay. The monument placement might be a bit too stalematey but that we will know only after a test.

I like the choice that you made by not doing quartz and you actually went with something different, mushroom blocks in this case.

Might need a bit more height variation near the frontlines but the map seems very nicely designed.

Great job.
